summary: Second implementation on a different stack. Added: Pages Functions variant for static-export projects, SDK pinning, throttle-substrate check before assuming no persistence, two-mode contract validator, live check against PR preview before merge, and the self-matching-assertion trap.

OpenAI submission manifest shapes learned by rejection: justifications are snake_case with _justification suffix while annotations are camelCase in the same object; exactly 5 test cases and 3 negative cases despite the schema saying minItems; tools_triggered is a single non-empty string, not an array, so a no-tool case cannot be a positive test. Added a copy-paste skeleton and a portal paste sheet.

Verified portal URLs (platform.openai.com/plugins, roles and org settings pages), privacy specifics that actually cause rejects (named recipients, real retention durations), icon generation from an existing square logo, and the set-var/redeploy/byte-compare ordering that avoids burning the single domain-verification fetch.
